note: Faults the mutation check reports as survivors that change no observable behaviour. The id carries a hash of the original line; an edit to that line makes the entry stale and fails the gate until it is reviewed.

equivalent.justification: instant(): the round-trip check (new Date(ms).toISOString() === v) implies the exact-format regex, so weakening the regex guard admits nothing; toISOString only ever produces that format.
instant(): same as above; with the regex guard removed a non-string or loosely formatted value still fails the round-trip and yields undefined.
trusted_keys ?? [] against ||: the two differ only for a falsy non-nullish config value such as 0, which is not a key list under either reading.
input.evidence ?? new Uint8Array() against ||: a Uint8Array is truthy even when empty, so both readings give the same buffer.
outer.signature ?? {} against ||: for a falsy non-nullish signature ('' or false) both readings reach algorithm_unsupported, since neither has an algorithm member.
